theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Industrials (+3.62%) and Technology (+3.26%) led the market today, while Energy (+0.18%) and Real Estate (+0.89%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +2.87% versus +1.44% for defensives and +1.63% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +2.37%, Dow +2.18%, Nasdaq +2.77% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +3.17%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 22.28% to 19.92, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.31% to $4,146.00, crude oil was little changed at $86.67, and bitcoin gained 0.22% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
